subject.title: feat: render inline web chat widgets via capability-gated show_widget tool

question: Should OpenClaw accept `requiredClientCaps` as a plugin-visible tool API and ship Canvas `show_widget` as the bundled web-chat inline widget surface once the CI blockers are fixed?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but it creates a durable plugin API contract and a model-authored HTML/script sandbox surface that require maintainer product and security-boundary ownership, not just mechanical review.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Fix the PR-added test type and extension-boundary failures, then land the generic capability seam and Canvas-owned widget surface with maintainer approval and green proof.

options.title: Narrow the API
options.body: Keep the widget idea but redesign or hide the capability contract until maintainers are ready to expose a plugin-visible tool availability API.

options.title: Pause the bundled feature
options.body: Defer or close the bundled `show_widget` work if maintainers want this to remain an external/plugin-only experiment for now.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the PR-added test type and extension-boundary failures, then land the generic capability seam and Canvas-owned widget surface with maintainer approval and green proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has adjacent Canvas/plugin history and is the maintainer-signal owner of this implementation, making him the best available owner for the API/security product choice.
